tools.name: what_can_you_do
tools.description: Describe a task in plain language (any language) and get back exactly which tools on this server do it, with ready-to-run example calls — instead of reading the whole catalogue and guessing. Also returns multi-step recipes when a task needs several tools chained (invoices to a ledger, a bank stateme

tools.name: pdf_add_page_numbers
tools.description: Stamp page numbers or footer text onto every page of a PDF. Supports a starting number, roman numerals, skipping a cover page, position and font size — the combination Acrobat cannot do without scripting. Template supports {n} and {total}, e.g. "Page {n} of {total}".

tools.name: md_to_pdf
tools.description: Markdown → styled PDF. Send markdown text or a URL to a .md file, get a print-ready PDF back.

tools.name: md_to_docx
tools.description: Markdown → Word (.docx). The deliverable your non-technical colleagues actually open.

tools.name: md_to_pptx
tools.description: Markdown (heading per slide) → PowerPoint .pptx. Fastest structured route to a deck.

tools.name: md_to_html
tools.description: Markdown → standalone styled HTML page (single file, inline CSS).

tools.name: md_to_epub
tools.description: Markdown → EPUB e-book, with title and author metadata.

tools.name: docx_to_md
tools.description: Word .docx (by URL) → clean Markdown. Feed documents to your agent pipeline.

tools.name: merge_pdf
tools.description: Merge several PDFs (by URL) into one. urls = comma-separated links, in order.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Extract a page range from a PDF (by URL) into a new PDF. from/to are 1-based page numbers.

tools.name: pdf_page_count
tools.description: Count pages and report each page size of a PDF (by URL).

tools.name: pdf_watermark
tools.description: Stamp diagonal text watermark on every page of a PDF (by URL). text = the watermark.

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Rotate all pages of a PDF (by URL) by 90/180/270 degrees.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "paper?s=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: md_to_pdf · Private data: md_to_pdf, md_to_html, docx_to_md · Public sink: md_to_pdf · Destructive: what_can_you_do.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: md_to_pdf · Private data: md_to_pdf, md_to_html, docx_to_md · Public sink: md_to_pdf · Destructive: what_can_you_do

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
